summary: Documentation-only rewrite for v1.1 Phase 10 task 10.3 (Goal F, ADR-020 clause 8). Rewrote docs/limitations.md SEC-5 from the pre-logging negative result ('the plugin has no logging call sites, so no plugin log path can leak a secret') to the ADR-020 redaction contract: SEC-5 now records that ArrTags logs through the host ILogger<T>/ILoggerFactory pipeline at the bounded, validated, secret-free LogVerbosity (default Warning, applied without restart); that every log call emits only bounded, already-redacted values per the clause 4 allowlist (ArrProviderError code/retryability/message, non-secret connection identity, configuration version, bounded reason codes/enums, item/record identifiers, and counts) and never an API key, webhook secret, SecretLease value, X-Api-Key/X-ArrTags-Webhook-Secret header, raw body, provider payload, or mutable PluginConfiguration; that the emitted shape is identical at every level; that volume is bounded by the code-owned LogThrottle; that verbosity is not output-affecting; and that the logging path is covered by a dedicated security review (docs/implementation/10.3/security-review.json). SEC-5 is reconciled with SEC-9 (the ADR-021 configuration-rejection activity-log entry) and keeps its INFORMATIONAL/noted marker. Updated docs/architecture.md section 11 (failure/security policy now states authentication failures and secret-bearing values are never logged and that log output is bounded/redacted), section 12 (removed the stale 'durations' from the emitted-value list, correcting task 10.2's informational finding 10.2-F2 since no duration is logged), and the architecture status line (task 10.3). Updated docs/data-model.md 3.12 to record the shipped log call sites and redaction contract, and README.md to state ArrTags logs only bounded, secret-free diagnostics. Added the optional ADR-020 implementation note (tasks 10.1-10.3) in docs/decisions.md without rewriting any clause. Reconciled the canonical current-state surfaces (PLANS.md Project Status/milestone row/task 10.3 status, docs/changelog.md, docs/project-status.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md) to reflect that the SEC-5 rewrite and documentation are complete and the logging security review remains an orchestrator-run step. No production code, tests, build scripts, artifacts, or ADR clauses were changed.

Exact behaviour: task 10.3's independent security review is run by the orchestrator via the security-reviewer subagent after this documentation change and recorded at docs/implementation/10.3/security-review.json; this worker did not run it and asserts no verdict. Precondition: the review is an orchestrator-run gate, per the task instruction. Consequence: task 10.3's 'the logging path is security-reviewed' acceptance criterion and the Phase 10 gate are not satisfied until that report is recorded with no open BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM (or any accepted limitation is recorded in docs/limitations.md); if the review raises a finding, this documentation may need a rework attempt.

Exact behaviour: host ILogger<T> resolution, ArrTags.* categories, verbosity gating, redaction, and the log-volume bound are established by the task 10.1/10.2 unit/integration tests; no live Jellyfin host was started here. The task 10.2 reliance on ArrProviderError.Message being redacted is inherited, not re-verified. Exact behaviour: the provider/matching boundaries log ArrProviderError.Message, which ArrProviderError bounds and documents as secret-free. Precondition: the provider clients that construct that message were not modified by this documentation-only task. Consequence: a future upstream construction defect could place a credential in that message; the redaction tests exercise the boundary with a fixed redacted message and cannot detect that upstream defect.
